name: Carboplatin + Paclitaxel (TC) for Endometrial Carcinoma
histology: endometrial carcinoma (histology-agnostic backbone; the printed source dose was reported in the uterine carcinosarcoma trials table and is the same standard TC doublet used for endometrial adenocarcinoma, serous, and clear cell carcinoma)

biomarkers.note: The cytotoxic carboplatin/paclitaxel (TC) backbone is not biomarker restricted. MMR or MSI and HER2 (ERBB2) status are tested to guide add on immunotherapy or HER2 directed therapy (checkpoint inhibitor add on for advanced disease, trastuzumab for HER2 positive uterine serous carcinoma or carcinosarcoma), not the doublet itself. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Uterine Neoplasms v3.2026, Systemic Therapy for Endometrial Carcinoma (ENDO-D) and Principles of Molecular Analysis (ENDO-A).

lineOfTherapy: first line for advanced (stage III to IV) and first line for recurrent endometrial carcinoma; also the adjuvant chemotherapy backbone for high risk surgically staged disease

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: advanced (stage III to IV) or recurrent endometrial carcinoma; category 1 for carcinosarcoma
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v3.2026, ENDO-D 2 of 6 (Carboplatin/Paclitaxel, category 1 for carcinosarcoma)

drugs.name: CARBOplatin

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 175767. CARBOplatin AUC 6 IV on day 1, every 21 days (target AUC). The narrative establishes carboplatin/paclitaxel (TC) as the standard for advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma from the GOG 209 comparison of TC to TAP (line 175095). Tall man per ISMP.

drugs.name: PACLitaxel

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 175767 (Carboplatin (AUC 6) + paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 q 3 wk); infusion duration per line 178646 (paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 3-h infusion every 21 d)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 175767. PACLitaxel 175 mg/m2 IV on day 1, every 21 days. Standard 3 hr infusion per the platinum/taxane doublet schedule (line 178646). Requires corticosteroid and H1/H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling. Tall man per ISMP.

regimen.cycles: typically 6 cycles in the adjuvant and advanced settings per the referenced trials; physician determined

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid plus H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling before each dose.

supportiveCare: antiemetics: carboplatin is moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier on the day of treatment.
G-CSF: not routinely required for the every 21 day TC doublet; assess febrile neutropenia risk factors per institutional and NCCN growth factor guidance.

monitoring: renal function (creatinine/GFR) before each cycle for carboplatin AUC dosing
peripheral neuropathy assessment before each cycle for PACLitaxel
infusion reaction monitoring for carboplatin and PACLitaxel

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Hold or reduce per institutional protocol; physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: lines 175095 (TC is the standard for advanced/recurrent endometrial carcinoma per GOG 209 vs TAP) and 175767 (Carboplatin AUC 6 + paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 q 3 wk); 178646 (paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 3-h infusion)

guideline.locator: Systemic Therapy for Endometrial Carcinoma, Recurrent Disease first line preferred, Carboplatin/Paclitaxel (ENDO-D 2 of 6; category 1 for carcinosarcoma)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for the carboplatin/paclitaxel (TC) doublet in endometrial carcinoma (StewardMD reference disease endometrial cancer, subtype group #43). Numeric doses are grounded to DeVita 12th ed. line 175767 (CARBOplatin AUC 6 plus PACLitaxel 175 mg/m2 every 21 days), with the 3 hr paclitaxel infusion per line 178646; DeVita line 175095 establishes TC as the standard for advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma from GOG 209. Regimen identity, setting, and category 1 status are cross referenced to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Uterine Neoplasms v3.2026, ENDO-D 2 of 6, which lists Carboplatin/Paclitaxel as a preferred first line recurrent option (category 1 for carcinosarcoma) but does not print per drug doses. The printed DeVita dose line sits in the uterine carcinosarcoma trials table and is the same standard TC doublet used across endometrial histologies. ISMP tall man applied (CARBOplatin, PACLitaxel). No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
